Class OpcodeColumn

java.lang.Object
net.emustudio.emulib.runtime.ui.debugger.OpcodeColumn
All Implemented Interfaces:
DebuggerColumn<String>
public class OpcodeColumn extends Object implements DebuggerColumn<String>
This class represents "opcode" column in the debug table.

The opcode means operating code - the formatted binary representation of the instruction.

    • isEditable

      public boolean isEditable()
      Description copied from interface: DebuggerColumn
      Determines whether this column is editable by user.

      For example, a "mnemo" column shouldn't be editable, but "breakpoint" column can (and should). Note that the returned value holds to all cells in the column.

      Specified by:
      isEditable in interface DebuggerColumn<String>
      Returns:
      true if the column is editable, false otherwise
